title: Wasted Woman Loses It! - Power Trip Tantrum
description:
On April 2nd, 2022, at 3:38 pm, Santa Fe Police Department responded to a two-vehicle crash at an intersection. When officers arrived Santa Fe Fire Department informed officers the female driver of the maroon Honda had admitted to drinking alcoholic beverages. Officers asked the driver to approach them and witnessed the driver stumbling before starting a DUI investigation.

Officers asked the suspect if she would be willing to perform a Field Sobriety Test to which she agreed. The suspect had difficulty performing the tasks of the Field Sobriety Test. The officers' reports stated the suspect had “bloodshot watery eyes” and a “strong odor of alcoholic beverages coming from her breath”. Based on their findings officers placed the suspect under arrest for DUI.

 After arresting the suspect officers transferred her to the Police Department to take breath samples and process her. The suspect's two BAC (Blood Alcohol Concentration) readings were 0.26 and 0.24. The legal limit is 0.08 in the State of New Mexico. The suspect was charged with Driving While Under the Influence of an Intoxicating Liquor and or Drugs (also known as DUI) and two traffic citations for Careless Driving and Failure to Yield.
